title: Rabbi Yochanan HaMakuti

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sukkah 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.45b.1): Rabbi Yochanan reports in the name of Rabbi Shimon HaMachuzi, who reports in Rabbi Yochanan HaMakuti's name. Hyman infers that he was one of the last Tannaim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Sukkah text has the report formula משום in this chain. The supplied notice instead prints כשם, interpreted in that reporting sense without changing its source text. The dating is Hyman’s inference.

[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1830&lang=en) records the same three-part chain under this name, but prints Sukkah 42b. Hyman’s dating as one of the last Tannaim is an inference from the chain.
